TEXAS INTERNSHIP RESOURCE

TXWORKS

Explore a Texas program that supports paid, off-campus internships for eligible undergraduate students, helping them build workplace skills and explore career options.

Explore TXWORKS ↗

Review student eligibility and current program availability on the official website. Requirements include Texas residency, enrollment, and financial eligibility. Current high school and dual-credit students are not eligible.

No paid account is needed for the basic searches and resources offered here. Some boards require free registration or advertise optional upgrades. Opportunities open on the boards; this tool does not display or verify live postings. Applying for internships directly on company websites is recommended. Internship postings on external websites are not verified or endorsed by Collin College. Students should independently research employers and opportunities before applying.

What should I look for in an opportunity?
  • A connection to the skills or career you want to explore.
  • Clear duties, supervision, schedule, pay information, and student eligibility.
  • Learning opportunities and examples of work you could later describe on your resume.
  • If you want course credit, speak with your program before accepting an opportunity. Credit is not automatic.

3Prepare your application

Found an opportunity you want to pursue? Use these tools to show how your coursework, projects, skills, and experience connect to the internship.

Resume Builder

Create or update your resume. Highlight relevant class projects, volunteer work, part-time jobs, and skills—even if this would be your first internship.

Open Resume Builder ↗

Cover Letter Builder

When a cover letter is requested or welcomed, explain why the opportunity interests you, what you can contribute, and how it connects to your career direction.

Open Cover Letter Builder ↗

Keep the posting handy so you can tailor your materials to the employer’s requirements. Follow the application instructions and review your documents before submitting.
